description: Use when reviewing SolidJS code for React anti-patterns or converting React components to SolidJS. Prevents destructured props, useState/useEffect habits, Array.map rendering, and all other React patterns that silently break SolidJS reactivity. Covers all 12+ contamination patterns including props destructuring, signal misuse, effect cleanup, list rendering, conditional rendering, refs, children, and navigation. Keywords: React to SolidJS, destructure props, createSignal, createEffect, For component, Show component, anti-pattern, migration.
